name: Shutdown or stoppage the employer causes

references.title: 民法 §487: the employer’s delay in accepting the work leaves the wage owed; the day is not an absence.

name: Stop-work ordered by the labour inspection authority

references.title: 職業安全衛生法 §36(2): 勞工於停工期間應由雇主照給工資.

name: Work stopped by a typhoon or other natural disaster

pay.name: 停工日工資扣除 (wage for unpaid suspended days)

references.title: The suspended working days a work suspension leaves unpaid, at the day wage (monthly ÷ 30, or ÷ the calendar days by agreement, as NO_PAY_LEAVE): a STRIKE day (民法 §482: no work, no wage), a NATURAL_DISASTER day whose suspension records facts.withhold_wage (天然災害發生事業單位勞工出勤管理及工資給付要點), and a 減班休息 day (REDUCED_WORK_AGREEMENT) — those capped so a monthly-paid full-time worker keeps the minimum wage (因應景氣影響勞雇雙方協商減少工時應行注意事項, https://www.mol.gov.tw/1607/1632/1640/12438/post). An employer shutdown or a government stop-work order is paid in full (民法 §487; 職業安全衛生法 §36(2)). On a semi-monthly entity the minimum-wage floor is each part’s share (÷ period.parts).

pay.eligibility: work.days.exists(d, has(d.suspended) && d.suspended != null && d.day_type == "WORK" && !d.worked && (d.suspended.kind == "STRIKE" || (d.suspended.kind == "NATURAL_DISASTER" && has(d.suspended.facts.withhold_wage) && d.suspended.facts.withhold_wage == true) || d.suspended.kind == "REDUCED_WORK_AGREEMENT"))
pay.rate: round(double(size(work.days.filter(d, has(d.suspended) && d.suspended != null && d.day_type == "WORK" && !d.worked && (d.suspended.kind == "STRIKE" || (d.suspended.kind == "NATURAL_DISASTER" && has(d.suspended.facts.withhold_wage) && d.suspended.facts.withhold_wage == true))))) * (terms.base_salary / (has(company.facts.day_wage_calendar_days) && company.facts.day_wage_calendar_days == true ? double(period.month_days) : 30.0)) + min(double(size(work.days.filter(d, has(d.suspended) && d.suspended != null && d.day_type == "WORK" && !d.worked && (d.suspended.kind == "REDUCED_WORK_AGREEMENT")))) * (terms.base_salary / (has(company.facts.day_wage_calendar_days) && company.facts.day_wage_calendar_days == true ? double(period.month_days) : 30.0)), (has(terms.employment_type) && terms.employment_type == "PART_TIME") ? double(size(work.days.filter(d, has(d.suspended) && d.suspended != null && d.day_type == "WORK" && !d.worked && (d.suspended.kind == "REDUCED_WORK_AGREEMENT")))) * (terms.base_salary / (has(company.facts.day_wage_calendar_days) && company.facts.day_wage_calendar_days == true ? double(period.month_days) : 30.0)) : max(0.0, terms.base_salary - (has(rules.minimum_wage) ? double(rules.minimum_wage.monthly) : 0.0)) / double(period.parts)), 1.0, "HALF_UP")

references.title: 天然災害發生事業單位勞工出勤管理及工資給付要點: not an absence and the attendance bonus untouched; the day’s wage may be withheld (the suspension’s facts.withhold_wage).
勞資爭議處理法 §54; 民法 §482: no work, no wage for the strike days; not attended.

name: 減班休息 agreed in writing to reduce hours

references.title: 因應景氣影響勞雇雙方協商減少工時應行注意事項: days off unpaid, a monthly-paid full-time worker’s month never below the minimum wage; insurance and pension kept.
